draftLaw: P13 lane (Alt Academy family: one brand, nine channels — the CAIE-native multi-subject hub plus eight subject channels; 985 uploads inventoried, 0 overlap with the shipped union beyond the 75-video business subject channel that IS the P12 pool): Tier B course anchors by machine-checkable session/paper codes (method paper-code, confidence high, boardMismatch false — same qualification; ANCHOR-GRANULARITY §5/§8; CIE paper-number routing: maths P1/P2/P3/P4(M1)/P5(S1)/P6(S2), sciences papers 1-3 AS / 4-5 A2, econ/accounting/business by paper level) + Tier A spec rows by the distinctive-token binding rule (df<=3, deduped tokens). The dominant class is the section-name binding: the Alt Academy format "Topic | Section | register" names the syllabus section verbatim in a pipe-field — the section's TOPIC/SUBTOPIC SPEC_POINTs bind as ONE multi-spec row at confidence low through the disclosed verbatim field-equality gate (node norm >= 8 chars, SUBTOPIC preferred). Four-gate topic lectures (verbatim/multi-uniq/title-token/title-pair), N.M section-marker narrowing and maths unit-token routing (S2/S1/M1/P1/P2/P3 to the spine's unit courses, shared units bound to BOTH the AS and A-level course) complete the ladder. Teacher-guidance/technique registers, the O-Level register, meta/marketing videos and CIE 9990 psychology (no spine course — honest no-target) are excluded and ledgered as skips (310). Degenerate binds (generic-token-only evidence) were re-adjudicated to honest skips on review (2). Rejected/unrouted videos stay out of videos[].
